metrics.name: Active Users Count
metrics.gotcha: Users[].expired is a STRING — "normal" means active, "now" means currently expired. Filter with == `normal` (backtick literal). Don't compare against true/false.

metrics.name: Admin Users Count
metrics.gotcha: See admin-users-list. Liongard catalog metric 398 still uses the old name-only query (counts every user): do not use it until it is corrected.

metrics.name: Admin Users List
metrics.okWhen: result contains only expected admin accounts
metrics.gotcha: GroupMembership is an array of {name, is_member} on DSM 6 and an object {groups: [...]} on DSM 7. Every user lists the administrators group with is_member true/false, so filter on is_member; matching the group name alone returns every user. Liongard catalog metric 397 still uses the old name-only query: do not use it until it is corrected.

metrics.name: SSD Disk Count
metrics.gotcha: Disks[].isSsd is a BOOLEAN (true/false), not a string. Filter with == `true` (backtick literal). remain_life is an OBJECT {trustable: bool, value: int}, not a scalar — use remain_life.value for the percentage integer.

metrics.name: Drives Not in Normal State (Count)
metrics.gotcha: drive_status_category / drive_status_key do not exist in current dataprints (DSM 6.2 and 7.1); filters on them always return 0 (a silent false pass). Use status. Liongard catalog metric 915 still uses the old fields: do not use it until it is corrected.

metrics.name: Drives Not in Normal State (List)
metrics.gotcha: drive_status_category / drive_status_key do not exist in current dataprints (DSM 6.2 and 7.1); filters on them always return 0 (a silent false pass). Use status. Liongard catalog metric 914 still uses the old fields: do not use it until it is corrected.

metrics.name: Enabled Services (List)
metrics.gotcha: Service state field varies: DSM 7 enable_status "enabled"/"disabled"/"static"; older DSM 6 enable_status "enable"/"disable"; newer DSM 6 boolean enable. Use the combined filter. If enabled + disabled is 0 while length(Services) > 0, report Not evaluated, never "no services enabled".

metrics.name: Unencrypted Shares Count
metrics.gotcha: Shares[].encryption is an INTEGER (0 = not encrypted, 1 = encrypted), NOT a boolean. Don't compare against `false`.
